685: func spawn_in(node: Node2D, dur: float = 0.3) -> Tween:
686: 	if not _is_valid(node):
687: 		return null
688: 	node.scale = Vector2.ZERO
689: 	node.modulate.a = 0.0
690: 	var t = _new_tween(node)
691: 	t.parallel().tween_property(node, "scale", Vector2.ONE, dur).set_trans(Tween.TRANS_BACK).set_ease(Tween.EASE_OUT)
692: 	t.parallel().tween_property(node, "modulate:a", 1.0, dur)
693: 	return t

255: func pop_scale(node: Node2D, factor: float = 1.3, dur: float = 0.15) -> Tween:
256: 	if not _is_valid(node):
257: 		return null
258: 	
259: 	# Uccidi il vecchio Tween prima di partire
260: 	if _pop_tweens.has(node) and is_instance_valid(_pop_tweens[node]):
261: 		_pop_tweens[node].kill()
262: 	
263: 	var s = node.scale
264: 	var t = _new_tween(node)
265: 	_pop_tweens[node] = t  # registra il nuovo
266: 	
267: 	t.tween_property(node, "scale", s * factor, dur).set_trans(Tween.TRANS_BACK).set_ease(Tween.EASE_OUT)
268: 	t.tween_property(node, "scale", s, dur).set_trans(Tween.TRANS_BACK).set_ease(Tween.EASE_IN)
269: 	
270: 	# Pulizia a fine animazione
271: 	t.finished.connect(func():
272: 		if _pop_tweens.get(node) == t:
273: 			_pop_tweens.erase(node)
274: 	)
275: 	
276: 	return t

235: func color_flash(node: CanvasItem, color: Color = Color.RED, dur: float = 0.15) -> Tween:
236: 	if not _is_valid(node):
237: 		return null
238: 	var original = node.modulate
239: 	var t = _new_tween(node)
240: 	t.tween_property(node, "modulate", color, dur * 0.5)
241: 	t.tween_property(node, "modulate", original, dur * 0.5)
242: 	return t

202: func show_canvas(node: CanvasItem, dur: float = 0.3) -> PropertyTweener:
203: 	return fade(node, node.modulate.a, 1.0, dur)

199: func hide_canvas(node: CanvasItem, dur: float = 0.3) -> PropertyTweener:
200: 	return fade(node, node.modulate.a, 0.0, dur)    # "from" is ignored but kept for API compatibility
